decisions.reason: Because A remained on its own webpage through 2024 and sits close to the firm's established interior offering, management is likely to continue backing a product it has already visibly introduced and invested in.

B still had a dedicated page in 2024, and as a premium carpet close to the existing range it is the kind of launched product management would persist with to justify prior commitment and allow for a longer market ramp-up.
C disappeared from the website by 2024, which signals that the firm's public commitment has already weakened enough that management is likely to stop supporting it in 2025.

D was still explicitly promoted in 2024 with launch language and extends the firm's core seating and interior solutions, so management would likely keep it as a recently backed product whose results can still be framed as developing.
E continued to be presented on its own page in 2024, and its closeness to the established offer makes it easy for management to justify ongoing support rather than reverse an already visible launch.
F retained a dedicated page in 2024 and fits the firm's direction toward contemporary living and working environments, increasing the chance that management stays committed despite any uncertainty.
